title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductors for Rated Voltages up to and Including 450/750 V
scope_text: Specifies constructional dimensions, electrical characteristics, and physical requirements for single-core and multi-core PVC insulated wires and flexible cords suitable for fixed electrical wiring installations and domestic appliances operating at rated AC voltages up to 450/750 V (often applied up to 1100 V).

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables — Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope_text: Covers design, manufacturing tolerances, insulation thickness, armouring, and routine testing for armoured and unarmoured heavy-duty PVC insulated power and control cables used in industrial electricity distribution up to 1.1 kV.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables — Part 2: For Working Voltages from 3.3 kV up to and Including 11 kV
scope_text: Applies to medium-voltage PVC insulated armoured cables suitable for operating voltages between 3.3 kV and 11 kV, detailing electrostatic screening requirements, dielectric tests, and insulation compounding.

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables — Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope_text: Specifies requirements for low-tension power cables insulated with thermosetting cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) for rated operational voltages up to 1.1 kV, designed for higher continuous operating temperature limits (90°C) compared to PVC.

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables — Part 2: For Working Voltages from 3.3 kV up to and Including 33 kV
scope_text: Covers medium and high voltage XLPE insulated power cables rated from 3.3 kV up to 33 kV, specifying triple-extrusion conductor and insulation screening, moisture barrier options, and impulse voltage withstand tests.

title: Crosslinked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables — Part 3: For Working Voltages from 66 kV up to and Including 220 kV
scope_text: Outlines specifications for extra-high-voltage (EHV) underground transmission cables insulated with dry-cured XLPE, covering working voltages from 66 kV to 220 kV with metallic radial water barriers and degassing procedures.

title: Elastomer Insulated Cables — Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope_text: Covers rubber/elastomer insulated single-core and multi-core flexible power cables for mobile machinery, industrial cranes, shipboard wiring, and temporary site installations operating up to 1.1 kV.

title: Elastomer Insulated Cables — Part 2: For Working Voltages from 3.3 kV up to and Including 33 kV
scope_text: Specifies high-voltage flexible elastomeric power cables for severe mechanical stress applications such as open-cast mining excavators, dredge equipment, and high-voltage portable substations operating from 3.3 kV to 33 kV.

title: Aerial Bunched Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope_text: Covers overhead distribution cables comprising insulated phase conductors bundled around a bare or insulated aluminium alloy neutral/messenger wire, designed for rural electrification and theft-resistant low-voltage power distribution.

title: Conductors for Insulated Electric Cables and Flexible Cords
scope_text: Defines nominal cross-sectional areas, maximum DC resistance values, solid and stranded configurations, and elongation properties for copper and aluminium conductors used in all insulated cables.

title: PVC Insulation and Sheath of Electric Cables
scope_text: Specifies chemical composition, physical properties, thermal stability, tensile strength, and cold bend requirements for various grades of PVC insulation and sheathing compounds applied to electric cables.

title: Elastomeric Insulation and Sheath of Electric Cables
scope_text: Specifies physical and electrical requirements for rubber and synthetic elastomeric compounds (including natural rubber, silicone, ethylene propylene rubber, and chloroprene) used for cable insulation and protective outer sheaths.

title: Low Carbon Galvanized Steel Wires, Formed Wires and Tapes for Armouring of Cables
scope_text: Covers dimensional criteria, tensile strength, zinc coating mass, and uniformity tests for mild steel galvanized round wires, flat formed wires, and strip tapes utilized for mechanical cable armouring.

title: Aluminium Conductors for Overhead Transmission Purposes — Part 1: Aluminium Stranded Conductors
scope_text: Specifies electrical and mechanical characteristics for all-aluminium stranded bare conductors (AAC) used for short-span overhead electrical power distribution networks.

title: Aluminium Conductors for Overhead Transmission Purposes — Part 2: Aluminium Conductors, Galvanized Steel-Reinforced
scope_text: Defines construction, wire dimensions, tensile breaking strength, and DC resistance for aluminium conductors reinforced with a galvanized steel wire core (ACSR) for long-span high-voltage overhead transmission lines.

title: Aluminium Conductors for Overhead Transmission Purposes — Part 3: Aluminium Conductors, Aluminized Steel-Reinforced
scope_text: Specifies requirements for aluminium conductors reinforced with aluminized (aluminium-coated) steel wire cores intended for high corrosion environments such as coastal transmission routes.

title: Aluminium Conductors for Overhead Transmission Purposes — Part 4: Aluminium Alloy Stranded Conductors
scope_text: Specifies physical and electrical parameters for heat-treated aluminium-magnesium-silicon alloy stranded conductors (AAAC) providing superior corrosion resistance and strength-to-weight ratio for overhead distribution.

title: Aluminium Conductors for Overhead Transmission Purposes — Part 5: Aluminium Conductors, Galvanized Steel-Reinforced for Extra High Voltage (400 kV and Above)
scope_text: Prescribes surface finish criteria, corona prevention limits, high-strength steel core specs, and bundle configuration requirements for ACSR conductors engineered for 400 kV, 765 kV, and ultra-high-voltage overhead transmission lines.

title: Welding Cables
scope_text: Specifies requirements for highly flexible single-core copper and aluminium cables insulated with tough elastomeric or PVC compounds designed for connecting arc welding equipment to electrode holders under heavy thermal and mechanical duty.

title: Thermocouple Compensating Cables
scope_text: Covers requirements for single and multi-pair insulated extension and compensating cables connecting thermocouples to temperature indicating instruments, detailing thermoelectric voltage tolerance classes.

title: Elastomer Insulated Flexible Trailing Cables for Use in Coal Mines
scope_text: Prescribes stringent safety construction, flame retardancy, tear-resistant outer sheath formulation, and individual core screening for flexible trailing power cables powering machinery in underground and open-cast coal mines.

title: Flexible Cables for Miners' Cap-Lamps
scope_text: Specifies flexible twin-core elastomer or polychloroprene insulated and sheathed cables designed to link portable miner cap-lamps with belt-worn accumulator batteries in hazardous underground environments.

title: Shot Firing Cables
scope_text: Covers twin-core single-wire and flexible cables intended for connecting electric blasting exploders to electric detonator circuits in mining, tunnelling, and quarrying blasting operations.

title: Halogen Free Flame Retardant (HFFR) Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope_text: Specifies requirements for low-smoke, zero-halogen, flame-retardant thermoplastic and cross-linked power and wiring cables up to 1.1 kV intended for high-occupancy buildings, hospitals, airports, and underground metro transit corridors.

title: Drums for Electric Cables
scope_text: Specifies construction, dimensional limits, barrel diameters, flange thickness, and preservative treatment for wooden and steel reels/drums used for packaging, transporting, and paying out electric cables.

title: Continuously Cast Copper Wire Rod for Electrical Purposes
scope_text: Defines chemical composition, electrical conductivity (min 100% IACS), oxygen content, and surface defect tolerances for electrolytic grade continuous cast copper wire rods used for drawing electrical conductors.

title: Winding Wires for Submersible Motors — Part 1: Conductor Data
scope_text: Covers conductor dimensions, resistance, and elongation characteristics of solid copper conductors utilized in polymer-insulated submersible pump motor windings.

title: Winding Wires for Submersible Motors — Part 2: Specifications for Individual Wires
scope_text: Details polymer insulation requirements (PVC, crosslinked polyethylene, or polyamide) for water-immersed submersible pump motor winding wires operating continuously under hydrostatic pressure.

title: Specifications for Particular Types of Winding Wires — Part 0: General Requirements — Section 1: Enamelled Round Copper Wire
scope_text: Specifies general requirements, dimensional tolerances, cut-through temperature, heat shock, flexibility, and breakdown voltage test criteria for enamelled round copper magnet wires used in electrical motor and transformer windings.

title: Specifications for Particular Types of Winding Wires — Part 8: Polyesterimide Enamelled Round Copper Wire, Class 180
scope_text: Prescribes requirements for Class 180 thermal index polyesterimide resin enamelled round copper winding wires used for high-temperature electrical coils, motors, and relays.

title: Specifications for Particular Types of Winding Wires — Part 13: Polyester or Polyesterimide Overcoated with Polyamide-Imide Enamelled Round Copper Wire, Class 200
scope_text: Specifies dual-coat dual-polymer enamelled round copper winding wire rated for Class 200 continuous thermal performance, suitable for heavy duty industrial motors and hermetic compressor units.

title: Code of Practice for Installation and Maintenance of Power Cables up to and Including 33 kV Rating
scope_text: Provides comprehensive engineering rules and best practices for trench excavation, direct burial depth, conduit routing, cable pulling tensions, bending radii, jointing techniques, and periodic dielectric maintenance for power cables up to 33 kV.

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations
scope_text: National code detailing design, selection of cable cross-sections, thermal insulation factors, short-circuit protection coordination, earthing arrangements, and inspection verification for building electrical wiring systems.

title: Electrotechnical Vocabulary — Part 32: Electric Cables
scope_text: Standardizes authoritative technical terminology, definitions, symbols, and classifications for power, control, and telecommunication electric cables, conductors, and insulation systems.

title: Recommended Short Circuit Ratings of Electric Cables
scope_text: Provides engineering calculation methods and thermal limitation curves for determining the maximum allowable symmetrical short-circuit current ratings for copper and aluminium cables with PVC, XLPE, and EPR insulations.

title: Cable Accessories for Extruded Power Cables for Rated Voltages from 3.3 kV up to and Including 33 kV — Part 1: Test Requirements
scope_text: Specifies electrical test sequences and performance benchmarks for indoor and outdoor terminations, heat-shrink and cold-shrink joints, and screen earthing kits designed for extruded power cables operating between 3.3 kV and 33 kV.

title: Cable Accessories for Extruded Power Cables for Rated Voltages from 3.3 kV up to 33 kV — Part 2: Cable Joints and Stop Ends
scope_text: Covers mechanical, thermal cycling under load, and dielectric withstand tests for straight-through joints, branch joints, transition joints, and stop ends fitted on MV extruded insulation power cables.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 0: General
scope_text: Establishes general testing conditions, sample conditioning guidelines, atmospheric temperature ranges, and instrument accuracy requirements applicable across all individual test parts of the IS 10810 cable testing series.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 5: Conductor Resistance Test
scope_text: Describes standard laboratory test procedures using Kelvin double bridge or digital micro-ohmmeter to measure DC electrical resistance of cable conductors and verify compliance with maximum limits normalized to 20°C.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 6: Thickness of Insulation and Sheath
scope_text: Specifies optical micrometer and pin-gauge measurement methods to determine minimum, average, and nominal wall thicknesses of extruded cable insulation and protective outer sheathing.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 7: Tensile Strength and Elongation at Break of Thermoplastic and Elastomeric Insulation and Sheath
scope_text: Details dumb-bell specimen preparation and tensile testing machine methodology for determining mechanical tensile strength and percentage elongation at break for cable polymers before and after accelerated ageing.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 11: Thermal Ageing in Air
scope_text: Specifies accelerated thermal oven ageing exposure conditions for polymeric insulation and jacket samples to predict long-term thermal degradation under operating service temperatures.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 43: Insulation Resistance
scope_text: Prescribes high-resistance electrometer and megohmmeter procedures for evaluating insulation resistance per unit length of cable immersed in water at specified test temperatures.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 45: High Voltage Test
scope_text: Outlines AC power-frequency and DC spark dielectric withstand voltage test procedures applied between conductor cores and outer metallic armour/water bath to detect pinholes and dielectric breakdown.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 53: Flammability Test
scope_text: Defines laboratory Bunsen burner apparatus and vertical test method to assess flame propagation resistance and self-extinguishing behavior of single insulated electric cables.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 58: Oxygen Index Test
scope_text: Specifies the test procedure for determining the minimum percentage concentration of oxygen in an oxygen-nitrogen mixture that will support candle-like combustion of cable jacketing materials at ambient temperature.

title: Methods of Test for Cables — Part 61: Flame Retardant Smoke Density Test
scope_text: Specifies photometric test apparatus and measuring procedures for evaluating light transmittance and smoke obscuration generated by burning cable samples in an enclosed cube chamber.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables — Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope_text: Former revision of the Indian Standard for heavy-duty PVC insulated power cables up to 1.1 kV; formally superseded by IS 1554 (Part 1): 1988. Kept in database for detecting outdated tender references.

title: Rubber Insulated Cables — Part 1: With Copper Conductors
scope_text: Legacy historical Indian Standard covering natural rubber vulcanized insulated cables with copper conductors; formally withdrawn and superseded by the IS 9968 elastomer cable series.
